decisions.reason: The enclosed laser workstation builds on the firm's established laser platform, so keeping it costs little, and after only one year with just a website mention its value is still uncertain, which makes keeping the option open the sensible choice.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core offer and has its own product page, so it is cheap to maintain within the existing sales and service network, and its early signals give no reason to abandon it.

The piezo inkjet printer complements the firm's strategy of matching technologies to each surface, has a dedicated page, and costs little to carry in a growing industry, so its uncertainty should be allowed to resolve rather than the option dropped.
